candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Payment is the deepest failing hop; inventory/redis succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503s are fast (~1ms) and include /readyz 503, suggesting unavailability rather than latency; exact fault (config, crash, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show gateway /v1/checkout 502 driven by order 502, which is driven by payment 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis succeed. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s including /readyz. Payment is the deepest failing hop, but the underlying cause of its 503s is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (error rate, dependency operations) to identify why /v1/authorizations returns 503
Payment pod/container status and restart or readiness events
Payment configuration and dependency health (e.g., downstream DB/HTTP) at incident time
